verdict.rationale: Cognee ships a first-party MCP server (cognee-mcp) explicitly documented to connect Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline, Continue, and Codex to the same memory store, and a runtime probe confirms the MCP server actually launches and responds to the MCP handshake locally and keylessly. This directly satisfies the 'share memory across off-the-shelf assistants' story. Missing for 10: explicit documented ChatGPT connector support and independent (non-first-party) confirmation that multiple assistants simultaneously share the same persisted memory across sessions.
